# `corr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
corr(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns Pearson coefficient of correlation between a set of number pairs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- corr, example 1
> SELECT corr(c1, c2) FROM VALUES (3, 2), (3, 3), (6, 4) as tab(c1, c2);
0.8660254037844387
```
